arms.noise: stock + -b 8 -ub 8 (a change that must not matter; sets the churn allowance)

distribution_gate.what: every next-token distribution of 18 replies, teacher-forced (4,608 positions), mods setup vs stock
distribution_gate.floor: 18 floor pairs that differ only by rounding stock already accepts (CPU vs GPU, cache size, batch size); 3 more were bit-identical and excluded
distribution_gate.unit: reply (flips cluster within replies: overdispersion p = 4.65e-230)
distribution_gate.line_is: the widest top-1 flip gap of any floor reply
distribution_gate.rule: fail if 2 or more test replies have a top-1 flip gap above the line (false-fail probability under no difference <= 0.0026); fixed before the run
distribution_gate.lm_none: -lm none vs the same setup without it: distributions identical at 4,608 of 4,608 positions; 59 session replies identical

benchmarks.rule: non-inferiority of mods vs stock with allowance psi0 = the churn of the noise arm against stock; one-sided z 1.645; pass iff upper <= 0, fail iff lower > 0; fixed before any row. Release passes iff both pass

LiveCodeBench.caveat: the noise arm was not noise-like (80% vs stock 49%, 17 vs 57 looping replies), so its 45-point allowance is inflated; the direct comparison is the meaningful one: 73 vs 69, McNemar p 0.66, no sign of harm or gain

finish_cycle: a reply that loops until the length cap; the pre-registered rule counts it as an answer
verdict: pass (MMLU-Pro pass, LiveCodeBench pass; distribution gate holds)
